name: grasshopper
description: Tiny side quests that get you outside. Gemma writes them, CLIP checks your photos on-device.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
